```
 * Purpose : Generic dialog based Win32 application.                        *

/*

#define NELEMS(a)  (sizeof(a) / sizeof((a)[0]))

static INT_PTR CALLBACK MainDlgProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);

/** Global variables ********************************************************/

static HANDLE ghInstance;

/****************************************************************************
 *                                                                          *
 * Function: WinMain                                                        *
 *                                                                          *
 * Purpose : Initialize the application.  Register a window class,          *
 *           create and display the main window and enter the               *
 *           message loop.                                                  *
 *                                                                          *
 * History : Date      Reason                                               *
 *           00/00/00  Created                                              *
 *                                                                          *
 ****************************************************************************/

int APIENTRY wWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE hPrevInstance, WCHAR *pszCmdLine, int nCmdShow)
{
    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icc;
    WNDCLASSEX wcx;

    ghInstance = hInstance;

    /* Initialize common controls. Also needed for MANIFEST's */
    /*
     * TODO: set the ICC_???_CLASSES that you need.
     */
    icc.dwSize = sizeof(icc);
    icc.dwICC = ICC_WIN95_CLASSES /*|ICC_COOL_CLASSES|ICC_DATE_CLASSES|ICC_PAGESCROLLER_CLASS|ICC_USEREX_CLASSES|... */;
    InitCommonControlsEx(&icc);

    /* Load Rich Edit control support */
    /*
     * TODO: uncomment one of the lines below, if you are using a Rich Edit control.
     */
    // LoadLibrary(L"riched32.dll");  /* Rich Edit v1.0 */
    // LoadLibrary(L"riched20.dll");  /* Rich Edit v2.0, v3.0 */

    /*
     * TODO: uncomment line below, if you are using the Network Address control (Windows Vista+).
     */
    // InitNetworkAddressControl();

    /* Get system dialog information */
    wcx.cbSize = sizeof(wcx);
    if (!GetClassInfoEx(NULL, MAKEINTRESOURCE(32770), &wcx))
        return 0;

    /* Add our own stuff */
    wcx.hInstance = hInstance;
    wcx.hIcon = LoadIcon(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(IDR_ICO_MAIN));
    wcx.lpszClassName = L"masterClass";
    if (!RegisterClassEx(&wcx))
        return 0;

    /* The user interface is a modal dialog box */
    return DialogBox(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(DLG_MAIN), NULL, (DLGPROC)MainDlgProc);
}

/****************************************************************************
 *                                                                          *
 * Function: MainDlgProc                                                    *
 *                                                                          *
 * Purpose : Process messages for the Main dialog.                          *
 *                                                                          *

 ****************************************************************************/

static INT_PTR CALLBACK MainDlgProc(HWND hwndDlg, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (uMsg)
    {
        case WM_INITDIALOG:
            /*

            return TRUE;

        case WM_SIZE:
            /*
             * TODO: Add code to process resizing, when needed.
             */

        case WM_COMMAND:
            switch (GET_WM_COMMAND_ID(wParam, lParam))
            {
                /*
                 * TODO: Add more control ID's, when needed.
                 */
                case IDOK:
                    EndDialog(hwndDlg, TRUE);
                    return TRUE;
            }
            break;

        case WM_CLOSE:
            EndDialog(hwndDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;

        /*
         * TODO: Add more messages, when needed.
         */
    }

    return FALSE;
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include "clipboard.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "docs.h"
#include "util.h"

static wchar_t* g_history[MAX_HISTORY];
int Clip_HistoryCount = 0;

void Clip_Add(const wchar_t* text)
{
    if (!text || Clip_HistoryCount >= MAX_HISTORY) return;
    g_history[Clip_HistoryCount++] = _wcsdup(text);
}

void Clip_DeleteAt(int index)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= Clip_HistoryCount) return;
    free(g_history[index]);
    for (int i = index; i < Clip_HistoryCount - 1; i++)
        g_history[i] = g_history[i + 1];
    Clip_HistoryCount--;
}

void Clip_ClearAll(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
    {
        free(g_history[i]);
        g_history[i] = NULL;
    }
    Clip_HistoryCount = 0;
}

const wchar_t* Clip_GetAt(int index)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= Clip_HistoryCount) return NULL;
    return g_history[index];
}

void Clip_RefreshListBox(HWND hList)
{
    SendMessageW(hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
        if (g_history[i])
            SendMessageW(hList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)g_history[i]);
}

BOOL Clip_SaveToFile(HWND hWnd, const wchar_t* path)
{
    FILE* f = _wfopen(path, L"w, ccs=UTF-16LE");
    if (!f) { Util_ShowLastError(hWnd, L"Save Clipboard History"); return FALSE; }
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
        if (g_history[i])
            fwprintf(f, L"%ls\n", g_history[i]);
    fclose(f);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL Clip_LoadFromFile(HWND hWnd, const wchar_t* path)
{
    FILE* f = _wfopen(path, L"r, ccs=UTF-16LE");
    if (!f) { Util_ShowLastError(hWnd, L"Load Clipboard History"); return FALSE; }

    Clip_ClearAll();

    wchar_t line[4096];
    while (fgetws(line, 4096, f) && Clip_HistoryCount < MAX_HISTORY)
    {
        size_t len = wcslen(line);
        if (len && line[len-1] == L'\n') line[len-1] = L'\0';
        Clip_Add(line);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return TRUE;
}

static void Clip_InsertSelectedIntoActiveEdit(HWND hDlg, HWND hList)
{
    int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    if (sel == LB_ERR) return;
    const wchar_t* txt = Clip_GetAt(sel);
    if (!txt) return;

    extern HWND g_hMDIClient;
    HWND hEdit = Docs_GetActiveEdit(g_hMDIClient);
    if (hEdit)
        SendMessageW(hEdit, EM_REPLACESEL, TRUE, (LPARAM)txt);
}

INT_PTR CALLBACK ClipboardManagerDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    HWND hList = GetDlgItem(hDlg, IDC_CLIPLIST);

    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_INITDIALOG:
        Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
        return TRUE;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDC_INSERTCLIPENTRY:
            Clip_InsertSelectedIntoActiveEdit(hDlg, hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_DELETECLIPENTRY:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR) { Clip_DeleteAt(sel); Clip_RefreshListBox(hList); }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_CLEARALLCLIPHIST:
            Clip_ClearAll();
            Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_SAVECLIPHIST:
            Clip_SaveToFile(hDlg, L"clipboard_history.txt");
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_LOADCLIPHIST:
            if (Clip_LoadFromFile(hDlg, L"clipboard_history.txt"))
                Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_CLOSECLIPMANAGER:
            EndDialog(hDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    return FALSE;
}

```

```
﻿#include <stdio.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <winuser.h>
#include <commctrl.h>
#include "include\cwin.h"
#include "resources.h"

static WNDCLASSW c_cwin;
static HWND c_hwnd;

HWND CWIN(wchar_t* cls_, wchar_t* ttl_, DWORD stls_,
          int X, int Y, int nWidth, int nHeight,
          HWND hWndParent, HMENU hMenu, HINSTANCE ghInstance, LPVOID lpParam)
{
    c_hwnd = CreateWindowW(cls_, ttl_, stls_, X, Y, nWidth, nHeight,
                           hWndParent, hMenu, ghInstance, lpParam);
    return c_hwnd;
}

BOOL RWIN(wchar_t* cls_, WNDPROC MWndProc, DWORD stls_, HINSTANCE ghInstance)
{
    ZeroMemory(&c_cwin, sizeof(c_cwin));
    c_cwin.lpszClassName = cls_;
    c_cwin.lpfnWndProc   = MWndProc;
    c_cwin.style         = stls_;
    c_cwin.hInstance     = ghInstance;
    c_cwin.hIcon         = LoadIconW(ghInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_MAINICON));
    c_cwin.hCursor       = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
```

```
﻿#include "docs.h"

HWND Docs_CreateEditor(HWND hChild, HINSTANCE hInst)
{
    return CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, L"EDIT", NULL,
                    WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | ES_MULTILINE |
                    WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL | ES_AUTOVSCROLL | ES_AUTOHSCROLL,
                    0, 0, 400, 300, hChild, (HMENU)IDC_CHILD_EDIT, hInst, NULL);
}

HWND Docs_GetActiveEdit(HWND hMDIClient)
{
    HWND hChild = (HWND)SendMessageW(hMDIClient, WM_MDIGETACTIVE, 0, 0);
    if (!hChild) return NULL;
    return GetDlgItem(hChild, IDC_CHILD_EDIT);
}

void Docs_ForwardEditCommand(HWND hMDIClient, int commandId)
{
    HWND hEdit = Docs_GetActiveEdit(hMDIClient);
    if (!hEdit) return;

    switch (commandId)
    {
    case IDM_EDIT_UNDO:       SendMessageW(hEdit, EM_UNDO, 0, 0); break;
    case IDM_EDIT_COPY:       SendMessageW(hEdit, WM_COPY, 0, 0); break;
    case IDM_EDIT_CUT:        SendMessageW(hEdit, WM_CUT, 0, 0); break;
    case IDM_EDIT_PASTE:      SendMessageW(hEdit, WM_PASTE, 0, 0); break;
    case IDM_EDIT_SELECTALL:  SendMessageW(hEdit, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1); break;
    }
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include "help_sys.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "clipboard.h"

void Help_PushTipToClipboard(void)
{
    Clip_Add(L"Tip: Use View → Clipboard History to insert saved entries into the active editor.");
}

INT_PTR CALLBACK HelpDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_INITDIALOG:
        return TRUE;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDC_COPYHELPTOHISTORY:
            Help_PushTipToClipboard();
            MessageBoxW(hDlg, L"Help tip added to Clipboard History.", L"Help", MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            return TRUE;

        case IDCANCEL:
            EndDialog(hDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    return FALSE;
}
```

```
﻿#include "include\LDWINS.h"
#include "resources.h"

static const char FRAME_CLASS[] = "CopilotURL2Frame";
static const char CHILD_CLASS[] = "CopilotURL2Child";

HWND LDWINS_CreateFrame(HINSTANCE hInst, LPCSTR title,
                        WNDPROC wndProc,
                        LPCSTR menuRes,
                        LPCSTR toolbarRes,
                        LPCSTR statusRes)
{
    WNDCLASSA wc = {0};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = wndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInst;
    wc.hIcon = LoadIconW(hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_MAINICON));
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1);
    wc.lpszClassName = FRAME_CLASS;
    RegisterClassA(&wc);

    WNDCLASSA wcc = {0};
    wcc.lpfnWndProc = DefMDIChildProcA;
    wcc.hInstance = hInst;
    wcc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_IBEAM);
    wcc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1);
    wcc.lpszClassName = CHILD_CLASS;
    RegisterClassA(&wcc);

    HWND hWnd = CreateWindowA(FRAME_CLASS, title,
                              WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_CLIPCHILDREN,
                              CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 1100, 740,
                              NULL, LoadMenuA(hInst, menuRes), hInst, NULL);
    return hWnd;
}

HWND LDWINS_CreateMDIClient(HWND hParent, HINSTANCE hInst, WNDPROC childProc)
{
    CLIENTCREATESTRUCT ccs = {0};
    ccs.hWindowMenu = GetSubMenu(GetMenu(hParent), 1);
    ccs.idFirstChild = 60000;

    HWND hMDIClient = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, "MDICLIENT", NULL,
                                      WS_CHILD | WS_CLIPCHILDREN | WS_VISIBLE | WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL,
                                      0, 0, 0, 0, hParent, (HMENU)1, hInst, &ccs);
    return hMDIClient;
}

HWND LDWINS_GetActiveChild(HWND hMDIClient)
{
    return (HWND)SendMessageW(hMDIClient, WM_MDIGETACTIVE, 0, 0);
}

HWND LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(HWND hMDIClient, HINSTANCE hInst,
                           LPCSTR title, WNDPROC childProc, DWORD style)
{
    MDICREATESTRUCTA mcs;
    mcs.szClass = CHILD_CLASS;
    mcs.szTitle = title;
    mcs.hOwner  = hInst;
    mcs.x = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.y = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.cx = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.cy = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.style = style;
    mcs.lParam = 0;

    return (HWND)SendMessageA(hMDIClient, WM_MDICREATE, 0, (LPARAM)&mcs);
}

void LDWINS_ResizeFrame(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(hWnd, &rc);
    HWND hMDIClient = FindWindowExA(hWnd, NULL, "MDICLIENT", NULL);
    if (hMDIClient)
        MoveWindow(hMDIClient, 0, 0, rc.right, rc.bottom, TRUE);
}

// Expose editor creation here for convenience
HWND Docs_CreateEditor(HWND hChild, HINSTANCE hInst)
{
    return CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, L"EDIT", NULL,
                    WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | ES_MULTILINE |
                    WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL | ES_AUTOVSCROLL | ES_AUTOHSCROLL,
                    0, 0, 400, 300, hChild, (HMENU)IDC_CHILD_EDIT, hInst, NULL);
}
```

```
#include <windows.h>
#include "LDWINS.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "app.h"
#include "docs.h"
#include "clipboard.h"
#include "help_sys.h"
#include "about.h"
#include "util.h"
#include "sessions.h"
#include "cwin.h"   // wrappers for Register + Create + buttons

// Globals
HINSTANCE g_hInst = NULL;
HWND g_hMDIClient = NULL;

// Forward declarations
LRESULT CALLBACK FrameWndProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
LRESULT CALLBACK ChildProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);

int APIENTRY wWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE hPrevInstance,
                      LPWSTR lpCmdLine, int nCmdShow)
{
    g_hInst = hInstance;

    // Register and create the main frame via LDWINS (uses Unicode icon/menu)
    HWND hFrame = LDWINS_CreateFrame(hInstance, "CopilotURL2",
                                     FrameWndProc,
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_MAINMENU),
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_TOOLBAR),
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_STATUS));
    if (!hFrame) return FALSE;

    ShowWindow(hFrame, nCmdShow);
    UpdateWindow(hFrame);

    // Create an initial document child
    LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(g_hMDIClient, g_hInst, "Document 1",
                          ChildProc, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW);

    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0))
    {
        if (!TranslateMDISysAccel(g_hMDIClient, &msg))
        {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
    }
    return (int)msg.wParam;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK FrameWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_CREATE:
        g_hMDIClient = LDWINS_CreateMDIClient(hWnd, g_hInst, ChildProc);
        return 0;

    case WM_SIZE:
        LDWINS_ResizeFrame(hWnd);
        return 0;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDM_FILE_NEW:
            LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(g_hMDIClient, g_hInst, "New Document",
                                  ChildProc, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW);
            return 0;

        case IDM_FILE_CLOSE:
            SendMessageW(g_hMDIClient, WM_MDIDESTROY, (WPARAM)LDWINS_GetActiveChild(g_hMDIClient), 0);
            return 0;

        case IDM_FILE_EXIT:
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;

        case IDM_EDIT_UNDO:
        case IDM_EDIT_COPY:
        case IDM_EDIT_CUT:
        case IDM_EDIT_PASTE:
        case IDM_EDIT_SELECTALL:
            Docs_ForwardEditCommand(g_hMDIClient, LOWORD(wParam));
            return 0;

        case IDM_VIEW_CLIPHISTORY:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_CLIPBOARDMANAGER), hWnd, ClipboardManagerDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_VIEW_SESSIONS:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_SESSIONMANAGER), hWnd, SessionManagerDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_HELP_HELP:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_HELPDIALOG), hWnd, HelpDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_HELP_ABOUT:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_ABOUTBOX), hWnd, AboutDlgProc);
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefFrameProcW(hWnd, g_hMDIClient, message, wParam, lParam);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK ChildProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    static HWND hEdit, hBtnInsert, hBtnClear;

    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_CREATE:
        // Create editor pane
        hEdit = Docs_CreateEditor(hWnd, g_hInst);

        // Create buttons using wrappers (right side)
        hBtnInsert = CWIN_Button(L"Insert Clipboard", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                                 420, 20, 160, 28, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_INSERT, g_hInst);
        hBtnClear = CWIN_Button(L"Clear Editor", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                                420, 60, 160, 28, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_CLEAR, g_hInst);
        return 0;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        if ((HWND)lParam == hBtnInsert && HIWORD(wParam) == BN_CLICKED)
        {
            // Insert selected clipboard history item into the active edit
            Clip_Add(L"Sample history item");
            const wchar_t* txt = Clip_GetAt(Clip_HistoryCount - 1);
            if (txt) SendMessageW(hEdit, EM_REPLACESEL, TRUE, (LPARAM)txt);
            return 0;
        }
        if ((HWND)lParam == hBtnClear && HIWORD(wParam) == BN_CLICKED)
        {
            SetWindowTextW(hEdit, L"");
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_SETFOCUS:
        SetFocus(hEdit);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefMDIChildProcW(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}
```

```
 int countDigits(int n){
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        int count = 0;
        if (n < 0) n = -n; 
        while (n > 0) {
            n /= 10;
            count++;
        }
        return count;
}

char * NUM2STRB(HWND hwnd, long nint){
	setlocale(LC_ALL, "en_US.UTF-8"); // Set a suitable locale
	int dgt;dgt = countDigits(nint)+1;
	char * nstrp;char nstr[dgt];
	nstr[dgt ] = L'\0';nstrp = nstr;
	nstrp = (char *)malloc((dgt ) * sizeof(char));
	
	sprintf(nstrp, "%d", nint);
	char gacPB[dgt];gacPB[dgt ] = L'\0';gacP = gacPB;
	gacP = (char *)malloc((dgt ) * sizeof(char));
	gacP = nstrp;//convACT(hwnd, nstrp, dgt);

	return gacP;
}

	int dgt;dgt = countDigits(nint)+1;

wchar_t * NUM2STR(HWND hwnd, int nint){
	setlocale(LC_ALL, "en_US.UTF-8"); // Set a suitable locale
	int dgt;	dgt = countDigits(nint);
	char * nstrp;	char nstr[dgt];
	nstrp = nstr;	sprintf(nstrp, "%d", nint);
	gwcP = convWCT(hwnd, nstrp, dgt);
	return gwcP;
}
wchar_t * convWCT(HWND hwnd,char * STR,int LSTR){ 
	setlocale(LC_ALL, "en_US.UTF-8"); // Set a suitable locale
	wchar_t * wcP;
	wchar_t wcB[LSTR];
	wcP = wcB;
	size_t convertedChars;

	int err = mbstowcs_s(&convertedChars, wcP, LSTR, STR, LSTR);

	if (err == 0) {
	printf("Successfully converted. Converted %zu wide characters.\n", convertedChars);
	wprintf(L"Wide string: %ls\n", wcP);
	//MessageBoxW(hwnd, wcP, L"Converted wcP", 0x00000000L);
	} else {
	printf("Error code: %d\n", err);
	}

	int buffer_size;
	buffer_size = LSTR ;
	wchar_t my_buffer[buffer_size];
	wcsncpy(my_buffer, wcP, buffer_size);
	FREEWT(wcP);
	wcP = NULL;
	return (pbuff( hwnd,STR));
}
wchar_t * pbuff(HWND hwnd,char * STR) {

	setlocale(LC_ALL, "en_US.UTF-8"); // Set a suitable locale
	const char * multiByteString = STR;
	wchar_t * wideStringBuffer = NULL;
	size_t requiredSizeInWords = 0;
	int sz_str;
	sz_str = strlen(multiByteString) ;
	errno_t err;

	err = mbstowcs_s(&requiredSizeInWords, NULL, 0, multiByteString, sz_str);

	if (err != 0) {
	//perror("Failed to determine required buffer size");
	return L"EXIT_FAILURE 1";
	}

	printf("Required buffer size (in wchar_t units): %zu\n", requiredSizeInWords);

	wideStringBuffer = (wchar_t *)malloc(requiredSizeInWords + 1 * sizeof(wchar_t));

	if (wideStringBuffer == NULL) {
	//perror("Failed to allocate memory");
	return L"EXIT_FAILURE 2";
	}

	size_t convertedCharsCount = 0;
	err = mbstowcs_s(&convertedCharsCount, wideStringBuffer, requiredSizeInWords, multiByteString, sz_str);

	if (err != 0) {
	// perror("Failed to convert multibyte string to wide string");
	return L"EXIT_FAILURE 3";
	}
	//printf("Converted wide string: %ls\n", wideStringBuffer);
	//printf("Number of characters converted (including null terminator): %zu\n", convertedCharsCount);

	size_t buffer_size;
	buffer_size = sz_str + 1;
	wchar_t gwcPb[buffer_size];
	gwcP = gwcPb;
	gwcP = (wchar_t *)malloc((requiredSizeInWords + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t));
	wcsncpy(gwcP, wideStringBuffer, buffer_size);
	gwcP[buffer_size] = L'\0';
	//MessageBoxW(hwnd, gwcP, L"Converted gwcP", 0x00000000L);
	free(wideStringBuffer);
	wideStringBuffer = NULL; // Good practice to set pointer to NULL after freeing

    return (gwcP);
}
void FREEWT(wchar_t * wcP){
	wcP=NULL;free(wcP);wcP=NULL;
}
```

```
 LRESULT CALLBACK AboutDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam){
    switch (uMsg){
        case WM_INITDIALOG:
            /*
             * Nothing special to initialize.
             */
            return TRUE;

        case WM_COMMAND:
            switch (wParam)
            {
                case IDOK:
                case IDCANCEL:
                    /*
                     * OK or Cancel was clicked, close the dialog.
                     */
                    EndDialog(hDlg, TRUE);
                    return TRUE;
            }
            break;
    }

    return FALSE;
}
```

- size: 2538

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include "sessions.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "clipboard.h"

static CLIPSESSION g_sessions[32];
static int g_sessionCount = 0;

static void Sessions_RefreshList(HWND hList)
{
    SendMessageW(hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_sessionCount; i++)
        SendMessageW(hList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)g_sessions[i].name);
}

INT_PTR CALLBACK SessionManagerDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    HWND hList = GetDlgItem(hDlg, IDC_SESSIONLIST);

    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_INITDIALOG:
        Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
        return TRUE;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDC_NEWSESSION:
            if (g_sessionCount < 32)
            {
                int idx = g_sessionCount++;
                swprintf(g_sessions[idx].name, 64, L"Session %d", idx + 1);
                swprintf(g_sessions[idx].filePath, MAX_PATH, L"session_%d.txt", idx + 1);
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_DELETESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                for (int i = sel; i < g_sessionCount - 1; i++)
                    g_sessions[i] = g_sessions[i + 1];
                g_sessionCount--;
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_LOADSESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                Clip_LoadFromFile(hDlg, g_sessions[sel].filePath);
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_SAVESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
                Clip_SaveToFile(hDlg, g_sessions[sel].filePath);
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_RENAMESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                wcscat(g_sessions[sel].name, L"*");
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_CLOSESESSIONMGR:
            EndDialog(hDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    return FALSE;
}
```

```
﻿#include "util.h"

void Util_CenterWindow(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rc);
    int w = rc.right - rc.left;
    int h = rc.bottom - rc.top;

    RECT desk;
    GetWindowRect(GetDesktopWindow(), &desk);
    int x = (desk.right - desk.left - w) / 2;
    int y = (desk.bottom - desk.top - h) / 2;

    SetWindowPos(hWnd, NULL, x, y, 0, 0, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOSIZE);
}

void Util_ShowLastError(HWND hWnd, LPCWSTR title)
{
    DWORD err = GetLastError();
    LPWSTR buf = NULL;
    FormatMessageW(FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM |
                   FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
                   NULL, err, 0, (LPWSTR)&buf, 0, NULL);
    MessageBoxW(hWnd, buf ? buf : L"(no message)", title, MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    if (buf) LocalFree(buf);
}
```

```
	__x_ABI_CWindows_CUI_CNotifications_CIToastNotification* toast = NULL;
	hr = notifFactory->lpVtbl->CreateToastNotification(notifFactory, inputXml, &toast);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		printf("%s:%d:: CreateToastNotification\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__);
		goto exit5;
	}

	hr = notifier->lpVtbl->Show(notifier, toast);
	if (FAILED(hr))
	{
		printf("%s:%d:: Show\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__);
		goto exit6;
	}

	// We have to wait a bit for the COM threads to deliver the notification
	// to the system, I think
	// Don't know any better, yielding (Sleep(0)) is not enough
	Sleep(1);

	exit6:
	toast->lpVtbl->Release(toast);
	exit5:
	notifFactory->lpVtbl->Release(notifFactory);
	exit4:
	notifier->lpVtbl->Release(notifier);
	exit3:
	toastStatics->lpVtbl->Release(toastStatics);
	exit2:
	inputXml->lpVtbl->Release(inputXml);
	exit1:
	RoUninitialize();
	exit0:
	Done(hr);
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>

// Global handles
HWND g_hMDIFrameWnd;
HWND g_hMDIClientWnd;

// Window procedures for MDI Frame and MDI Child windows
LRESULT CALLBACK MDIFrameWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);
LRESULT CALLBACK MDIChildWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE hPrevInstance, LPSTR lpCmdLine, int nCmdShow) {
    // 1. Register MDI Frame Window Class
    // 2. Register MDI Child Window Class

    // 3. Create MDI Frame Window (g_hMDIFrameWnd)

    // Message loop
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessage(&msg, NULL, 0, 0)) {
        if (!TranslateMDISysAccel(g_hMDIClientWnd, &msg) && !TranslateAccelerator(g_hMDIFrameWnd, NULL, &msg)) {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessage(&msg);
        }
    }
    return (int)msg.wParam;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK MDIFrameWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (message) {
        case WM_CREATE: {
            CLIENTCREATESTRUCT ccs;
            ccs.hWindowMenu = GetSubMenu(GetMenu(hWnd), 0); // Example: assuming "Window" menu is at index 0
            ccs.idFirstChild = 1; // A custom ID for the first child window

            // 4. Create MDI Client Window (g_hMDIClientWnd)
            g_hMDIClientWnd = CreateWindowEx(
                WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE,
                TEXT("MDICLIENT"),
                NULL,
                WS_CHILD | WS_CLIPCHILDREN | WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL,
                0, 0, 0, 0,
                hWnd,
                (HMENU)1, // Child window ID
                ((LPCREATESTRUCT)lParam)->hInstance,
                (LPVOID)&ccs
            );
            ShowWindow(g_hMDIClientWnd, SW_SHOW);
            break;
        }
        case WM_COMMAND: {
            switch (LOWORD(wParam)) {
                case 1: { // Example menu item for creating a new child
                    MDICREATESTRUCT mcs;
                    // Fill mcs with desired properties for the new child window
                    // ...
                    SendMessage(g_hMDIClientWnd, WM_MDICREATE, 0, (LPARAM)&mcs);
                    break;
                }
                // Handle other menu commands (e.g., tile, cascade, close child)
            }
            break;
        }
        case WM_DESTROY:
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            break;
        default:
            return DefFrameProc(hWnd, g_hMDIClientWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return 0;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK MDIChildWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (message) {
        // Handle messages specific to the child window's content
        case WM_DESTROY:
            // Clean up resources for this child window
            break;
        default:
            return DefMDIChildProc(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

- size: 2729
```
Attribute VB_Name = "AICommandConsole"
Option Explicit

Private DebugMode As Boolean

Private Sub Form_Load()
    DebugMode = False
    AppendOutput "AI Command Console Loaded."
    AppendOutput "Type '/help' for available commands."
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRun_Click()
    HandleCommand Trim$(txtInput.Text)
    txtInput.Text = ""
End Sub

Private Sub txtInput_KeyPress(KeyAscii As Integer)
    If KeyAscii = 13 Then
        KeyAscii = 0
        cmdRun_Click
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub HandleCommand(ByVal cmd As String)
    If Len(cmd) = 0 Then Exit Sub

    AppendOutput "> " & cmd
    LogInfo "AICommand: " & cmd

    Select Case LCase$(cmd)

        Case "/help"
            AppendOutput "Commands:"
            AppendOutput " /help        - Show commands"
            AppendOutput " /clear       - Clear console"
            AppendOutput " /log         - Show last 20 log entries"
            AppendOutput " /os          - Show OS info"
            AppendOutput " /time        - Show system time"
            AppendOutput " /whoami      - Identify system user"
            AppendOutput " /debug on    - Enable debug mode"
            AppendOutput " /debug off   - Disable debug mode"

        Case "/clear"
            txtOutput.Text = ""

        Case "/os"
            AppendOutput "OS Environment: " & Environ$("OS")

        Case "/time"
            AppendOutput "System Time: " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")

        Case "/whoami"
            AppendOutput "User: " & Environ$("USERNAME")

        Case "/log"
            ShowLastLogs

        Case "/debug on"
            DebugMode = True
            AppendOutput "Debug mode enabled."

        Case "/debug off"
            DebugMode = False
            AppendOutput "Debug mode disabled."

        Case Else
            AppendOutput "Unknown command. Type /help."
    End Select

End Sub

Private Sub AppendOutput(ByVal msg As String)
    txtOutput.SelText = msg & vbCrLf
    If DebugMode Then LogDebug msg
End Sub

Private Sub ShowLastLogs()
    Dim logfile As String
    logfile = App.Path & "\Logs\AIWorkspace.log"

    If Dir$(logfile) = "" Then
        AppendOutput "No log file found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim buffer As String, line As String
    Dim f As Integer, count As Long
    Dim lines() As String

    f = FreeFile
    Open logfile For Input As #f
    Do Until EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        buffer = buffer & line & vbCrLf
    Loop
    Close #f

    lines = Split(buffer, vbCrLf)
    For count = UBound(lines) - 20 To UBound(lines)
        If count >= 0 Then AppendOutput lines(count)
    Next count
End Sub


```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "ChildLogViewer"
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Load()
    RefreshLog
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRefresh_Click()
    RefreshLog
End Sub

Private Sub RefreshLog()
    Dim logfile As String
    logfile = App.Path & "\Logs\AIWorkspace.log"

    If Dir$(logfile) = "" Then
        txtLog.Text = "Log file not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim f As Integer, line As String
    txtLog.Text = ""

    f = FreeFile
    Open logfile For Input As #f
    Do Until EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        txtLog.SelText = line & vbCrLf
    Loop
    Close #f
End Sub
```

```
Option Explicit
Public Const DS_COLOR_BG As Long = &H101010
Public Const DS_COLOR_PANEL As Long = &H202020
Public Const DS_COLOR_TEXT As Long = &HDDDDDD
Public Const DS_COLOR_ACCENT As Long = &H2A7FFF
Public Sub ApplyDarkTheme(frm As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    frm.BackColor = DS_COLOR_BG
    frm.ForeColor = DS_COLOR_TEXT
    Dim ctl As Control
    For Each ctl In frm.Controls
        Select Case TypeName(ctl)
        Case "TextBox", "TextBox32"
            ctl.BackColor = DS_COLOR_PANEL
            ctl.ForeColor = DS_COLOR_TEXT
        Case "Label"
            ctl.ForeColor = DS_COLOR_TEXT
        Case "CommandButton"
            Call DS_StyleButton(ctl)
        Case "ListBox", "ComboBox"
            ctl.BackColor = DS_COLOR_PANEL
            ctl.ForeColor = DS_COLOR_TEXT
        Case "PictureBox", "Frame"
            ctl.BackColor = DS_COLOR_PANEL
        End Select
    Next ctl
End Sub
Public Sub DS_StyleButton(btn As CommandButton)
    On Error Resume Next
    btn.BackColor = DS_COLOR_PANEL
    btn.ForeColor = DS_COLOR_TEXT
    btn.FontBold = True
End Sub

```

- sha: 06dbfbe46c63155b6c6f2aa9a2a941455ffd2ba419f28032366e4f07be481872
- size: 850
```
Option Explicit
Public Const DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD As Long = 24
Public Sub SnapToEdge(child As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim px As Long, py As Long, pw As Long, ph As Long
    Dim cx As Long, cy As Long, cw As Long, ch As Long
    px = child.Parent.ScaleLeft
    py = child.Parent.ScaleTop
    pw = child.Parent.ScaleWidth
    ph = child.Parent.ScaleHeight
    cx = child.Left
    cy = child.Top
    cw = child.Width
    ch = child.Height
    If Abs(cx - px) <= DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD Then child.Left = px
    If Abs((cx + cw) - (px + pw)) <= DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD Then child.Left = (px + pw) - cw
    If Abs(cy - py) <= DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD Then child.Top = py
    If Abs((cy + ch) - (py + ph)) <= DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD Then child.Top = (py + ph) - ch
    If Abs((cx + cw/2) - (px + pw/2)) <= DS_SNAP_THRESHOLD Then child.Left = (px + (pw - cw) / 2)
End Sub

```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "modMenuAPI"
Option Explicit

' ---- Win32 Menu Constants ----
Public Const MF_STRING As Long = &H0&
Public Const MF_POPUP As Long = &H10&
Public Const MF_SEPARATOR As Long = &H800&

' ---- Win32 Handles ----
Public Declare Function CreateMenu Lib "user32" () As Long
Public Declare Function CreatePopupMenu Lib "user32" () As Long
Public Declare Function SetMenu Lib "user32" (ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal hMenu As Long) As Long
Public Declare Function DrawMenuBar Lib "user32" (ByVal hWnd As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function AppendMenu Lib "user32" Alias "AppendMenuA" ( _
    ByVal hMenu As Long, _
    ByVal wFlags As Long, _
    ByVal wIDNewItem As Long, _
    ByVal lpNewItem As String) As Long

' ---- Menu IDs (you can expand these later) ----
Public Enum MENU_IDS
   ID_FILE_EXIT = 1001
   ID_TOOLS_CONSOLE = 1101
   ID_TOOLS_LOGVIEW = 1102
   ID_HELP_ABOUT = 1201
End Enum

' ===========================================================
' CreateMenusForMDI
' Called from MDIForm_Load
' Builds all menus dynamically without VB6 menu designer
' ===========================================================
Public Sub CreateMenusForMDI(ByVal hWnd As Long)

    Dim hMain As Long
    Dim hFile As Long
    Dim hTools As Long
    Dim hHelp As Long

    ' Create the main top-level menu bar
    hMain = CreateMenu()

    ' Create submenu handles
    hFile = CreatePopupMenu()
    hTools = CreatePopupMenu()
    hHelp = CreatePopupMenu()

    ' ----- FILE MENU -----
    AppendMenu hFile, MF_STRING, ID_FILE_EXIT, "&Exit"

    ' ----- TOOLS MENU -----
    AppendMenu hTools, MF_STRING, ID_TOOLS_CONSOLE, "AI &Console"
    AppendMenu hTools, MF_STRING, ID_TOOLS_LOGVIEW, "&Log Viewer"

    ' ----- HELP MENU -----
    AppendMenu hHelp, MF_STRING, ID_HELP_ABOUT, "&About"

    ' Add submenus to menu bar
    AppendMenu hMain, MF_POPUP, hFile, "&File"
    AppendMenu hMain, MF_POPUP, hTools, "&Tools"
    AppendMenu hMain, MF_POPUP, hHelp, "&Help"

    ' Attach the menu bar to the window
    SetMenu hWnd, hMain
    DrawMenuBar hWnd

End Sub
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "modSubclass"
Option Explicit

Public Declare Function SetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowLongA" _
    (ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal nIndex As Long, ByVal dwNewLong As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function CallWindowProc Lib "user32" Alias "CallWindowProcA" _
    (ByVal lpPrevWndFunc As Long, ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal Msg As Long, _
     ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long

Private Const GWL_WNDPROC = -4

Private oldProc As Long
Private callback As Long

Public Sub HookWindow(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal newProc As Long)
    callback = newProc
    oldProc = SetWindowLong(hWnd, GWL_WNDPROC, newProc)
End Sub

Public Function MDIForm1_WndProcProxy(ByVal hWnd As Long, _
    ByVal Msg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long

    ' Forward message to actual handler
    CallByName MDIForm1, "MDIForm1_WndProc", VbMethod, Msg, wParam, lParam

    ' Pass to original handler
    MDIForm1_WndProcProxy = CallWindowProc(oldProc, hWnd, Msg, wParam, lParam)
End Function
```

```
Option Explicit
Public Sub DS_SetUIFont(frm As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim ctl As Control
    frm.FontName = "Segoe UI"
    frm.FontSize = 8
    For Each ctl In frm.Controls
        Select Case TypeName(ctl)
        Case "Label", "TextBox", "CommandButton", "ComboBox", "ListBox"
            ctl.FontName = "Segoe UI"
            ctl.FontSize = 8
        End Select
    Next ctl
End Sub
Public Function DS_CreatePanel(frm As Object, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single)
    Dim pb As PictureBox
    Set pb = frm.Controls.Add("VB.PictureBox", "DS_Panel_" & CStr(Timer))
    pb.Move Left, Top, Width, Height
    pb.BackColor = &H202020
    Set DS_CreatePanel = pb
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "clipboardFrm"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Explicit

Dim ClipHistory As Collection

Private Sub cmdSelectAll_Click()
    ' Select all text in txtEditor
    Call SendMessage(txtEditor.hWnd, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1)
End Sub

Private Sub cmdReplaceSelection_Click()
    ' Replace current selection with new text
    Call SendMessage(txtEditor.hWnd, EM_REPLACESEL, 1, StrPtr("Inserted Text"))
End Sub


Private Sub Form_Load()
    Set ClipHistory = New Collection
End Sub

Private Sub cmdSave_Click()
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim FileName As String
    
    FileName = App.Path & "\notes.txt"
    f = FreeFile
    Open FileName For Output As #f
        Print #f, txtEditor.Text
    Close #f
    
    MsgBox "File saved to " & FileName, vbInformation
End Sub
Private Sub cmdClear_Click()
    ' Clear the ListBox
    lstClipboard.Clear
    
    ' Reset the collection
    Set ClipHistory = New Collection
    
    ' Clear the Windows clipboard too
    clipboard.Clear
    
    MsgBox "Clipboard history cleared.", vbInformation
End Sub


Private Sub cmdCopy_Click()
    cmdClear_Click
    clipboard.SetText txtEditor.SelText
    
    If txtEditor.SelText <> "" Then
        ClipHistory.Add txtEditor.SelText
        lstClipboard.AddItem txtEditor.SelText
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPaste_Click()
    If lstClipboard.ListIndex >= 0 Then
        txtEditor.SelText = lstClipboard.List(lstClipboard.ListIndex)
    End If
End Sub
```

```
﻿' === FORM NAME: frmTopMostAPI ===
VERSION 5.00
Begin VB.Form frmTopMostAPI
   Caption         =   "TopMost Clipboard (WinAPI)"
   ClientHeight    =   6000
   ClientWidth     =   8000
   ScaleHeight     =   6000
   ScaleWidth      =   8000
   StartUpPosition =   2  'CenterScreen
End
Attribute VB_Name = "frmTopMostAPI"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Explicit

' Handles to API controls
Private hEdit As Long
Private hList As Long
Private hBtnCopy As Long
Private hBtnPaste As Long
Private hBtnClear As Long
Private hFont As Long

Private Sub Form_Load()
    ' Make the form TopMost
    SetTopMost Me.hWnd, True

    ' Create a UI font
    hFont = CreateUIFont("Segoe UI", 10)

    ' Create EDIT (multiline)
    hEdit = CreateEdit(Me.hWnd, 200, 200, 5000, 4000, IDC_EDIT)
    ApplyFont hEdit, hFont

    ' Create LISTBOX
    hList = CreateListBox(Me.hWnd, 5400, 1800, 2000, 3000, IDC_LIST)
    ApplyFont hList, hFont

    ' Create BUTTONS
    hBtnCopy = CreateButton(Me.hWnd, "Copy", 5400, 200, 2000, 400, IDC_BTN_COPY)
    hBtnPaste = CreateButton(Me.hWnd, "Paste", 5400, 700, 2000, 400, IDC_BTN_PASTE)
    hBtnClear = CreateButton(Me.hWnd, "Clear Clipboard", 5400, 1200, 2000, 400, IDC_BTN_CLEAR)
    ApplyFont hBtnCopy, hFont
    ApplyFont hBtnPaste, hFont
    ApplyFont hBtnClear, hFont

    ' Subclass form to catch WM_COMMAND from child controls
    InstallSubclass Me.hWnd
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Remove subclass, destroy controls, free font
    RemoveSubclass Me.hWnd

    If hEdit <> 0 Then DestroyWindow hEdit: hEdit = 0
    If hList <> 0 Then DestroyWindow hList: hList = 0
    If hBtnCopy <> 0 Then DestroyWindow hBtnCopy: hBtnCopy = 0
    If hBtnPaste <> 0 Then DestroyWindow hBtnPaste: hBtnPaste = 0
    If hBtnClear <> 0 Then DestroyWindow hBtnClear: hBtnClear = 0

    If hFont <> 0 Then DeleteObject hFont: hFont = 0
End Sub

' ===== Handlers invoked by subclass (WM_COMMAND routing) =====

Public Sub HandleCopy()
    Dim txt As String, selStart As Long, selEnd As Long, s As String
    txt = GetEditText(hEdit)
    Call GetSelectionRange(hEdit, selStart, selEnd)

    If selEnd > selStart And Len(txt) > 0 Then
        s = Mid$(txt, selStart + 1, selEnd - selStart)
        Clipboard.Clear
        Clipboard.SetText s
        ListBoxAddString hList, s
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub HandlePaste()
    Dim s As String
    s = ListBoxGetSelectedText(hList)
    If Len(s) > 0 Then
        ReplaceSelection hEdit, s
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub HandleClear()
    ListBoxClear hList
    Clipboard.Clear
End Sub
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "MSCP_CLIP_API"
Option Explicit

' === API DECLARATIONS ===
Public Declare Function SetWindowPos Lib "user32" ( _
    ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal hWndInsertAfter As Long, _
    ByVal x As Long, ByVal y As Long, _
    ByVal cx As Long, ByVal cy As Long, _
    ByVal wFlags As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function CreateWindowEx Lib "user32" Alias "CreateWindowExA" ( _
    ByVal dwExStyle As Long, ByVal lpClassName As String, _
    ByVal lpWindowName As String, ByVal dwStyle As Long, _
    ByVal x As Long, ByVal y As Long, _
    ByVal nWidth As Long, ByVal nHeight As Long, _
    ByVal hWndParent As Long, ByVal hMenu As Long, _
    ByVal hInstance As Long, ByVal lpParam As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function SendMessage Lib "user32" Alias "SendMessageA" ( _
    ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal wMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function SendMessageStr Lib "user32" Alias "SendMessageA" ( _
    ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal wMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As String) As Long

Public Declare Function SetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowLongA" ( _
    ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal nIndex As Long, ByVal dwNewLong As Long) As Long

Public Declare Function CallWindowProc Lib "user32" Alias "CallWindowProcA" ( _
    ByVal lpPrevWndFunc As Long, ByVal hWnd As Long, _
    ByVal msg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long

' === CONSTANTS ===
Public Const GWL_WNDPROC = -4
Public Const WM_LBUTTONDOWN = &H201
Public Const WM_COMMAND = &H111
Public Const WM_GETTEXT = &HD
Public Const WM_GETTEXTLENGTH = &HE
Public Const WM_SETTEXT = &HC
Public Const EM_REPLACESEL = &HC2

Public Const LB_ADDSTRING = &H180
Public Const LB_RESETCONTENT = &H184
Public Const LB_GETCURSEL = &H188
Public Const LB_GETTEXT = &H189
Public Const LB_GETTEXTLEN = &H18A

Public Const WS_CHILD = &H40000000
Public Const WS_VISIBLE = &H10000000
Public Const WS_BORDER = &H800000
Public Const WS_TABSTOP = &H10000
Public Const BS_PUSHBUTTON = &H0&

Public Const ES_MULTILINE = &H4
Public Const ES_AUTOVSCROLL = &H40
Public Const WS_VSCROLL = &H200000

Public Const LBN_SELCHANGE = 1

Public Const GROW_CHUNK As Long = 50

' Topmost / SWP constants
Public Const HWND_TOPMOST As Long = -1
Public Const HWND_NOTOPMOST As Long = -2
Public Const SWP_NOMOVE As Long = &H2
Public Const SWP_NOSIZE As Long = &H1
Public Const SWP_SHOWWINDOW As Long = &H40

' === CONTROL IDs ===
Public Const IDC_EDIT = 1001
Public Const IDC_LIST = 1002
Public Const IDC_BTN_COPY = 1003
Public Const IDC_BTN_PASTE = 1004
Public Const IDC_BTN_CLEAR = 1005
Public Const IDC_BTN_SAVE_MARKUP = 1006
Public Const IDC_MARKUP = 1007

' === GLOBAL HANDLES ===
Public hEdit As Long
Public hList As Long
Public hBtnCopy As Long
Public hBtnPaste As Long
Public hBtnClear As Long
Public hBtnSaveMarkup As Long
Public hMarkup As Long

Public gPrevProcCopy As Long
Public gPrevProcPaste As Long
Public gPrevProcClear As Long
Public gPrevProcList As Long

' === LOGGING DATA ===
Public ClipList() As String
Public MarkupList() As String
Public logFilePath As String

' --------------------------------
' Helper: Check if MarkupList is initialized
' --------------------------------
Public Function IsMarkupInitialized() As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim u As Long
    u = UBound(MarkupList)
    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        IsMarkupInitialized = True
    Else
        IsMarkupInitialized = False
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Public Function MarkupCount() As Long
    If Not IsMarkupInitialized() Then
        MarkupCount = 0
    Else
        MarkupCount = UBound(MarkupList) + 1
    End If
End Function

Public Function GetMarkupItem(ByVal i As Long) As String
    If Not IsMarkupInitialized() Then
        GetMarkupItem = ""
    ElseIf i < LBound(MarkupList) Or i > UBound(MarkupList) Then
        GetMarkupItem = ""
    Else
        GetMarkupItem = MarkupList(i)
    End If
End Function

Public Sub AddMarkup(ByVal s As String)
    MarkupList_Add s
End Sub

Public Sub ClearMarkup()
    ReDim MarkupList(0)
    MarkupList(0) = ""
End Sub

' --------------------------------
' Capacity / Resizing
' --------------------------------
Private Sub EnsureClipCapacity(Optional ByVal additionalNeeded As Long = 1)
    Dim currentSize As Long
    If (Not (Not ClipList)) Then
        currentSize = UBound(ClipList) + 1
    Else
        currentSize = 0
    End If
    If currentSize < additionalNeeded Then
        Dim newSize As Long
        newSize = currentSize + GROW_CHUNK
        ReDim Preserve ClipList(newSize - 1)
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub EnsureMarkupCapacity(Optional ByVal additionalNeeded As Long = 1)
    Dim currentSize As Long
    If (Not (Not MarkupList)) Then
        currentSize = UBound(MarkupList) + 1
    Else
        currentSize = 0
    End If
    If currentSize < additionalNeeded Then
        Dim newSize As Long
        newSize = currentSize + GROW_CHUNK
        ReDim Preserve MarkupList(newSize - 1)
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub ClipList_Add(ByVal s As String)
    EnsureClipCapacity 1
    Dim idx As Long
    If (Not (Not ClipList)) Then
        idx = UBound(ClipList)
    Else
        idx = 0
    End If
    ClipList(idx) = s
End Sub

Public Sub MarkupList_Add(ByVal s As String)
    EnsureMarkupCapacity 1
    Dim idx As Long
    If (Not (Not MarkupList)) Then
        idx = UBound(MarkupList)
    Else
        idx = 0
    End If
    MarkupList(idx) = s
End Sub

' --------------------------------
' Logging File I/O
' --------------------------------
Public Sub LoadLogFile(ByVal filePath As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim L As String
    Dim mode As String

    logFilePath = filePath

    Erase ClipList
    Erase MarkupList

    f = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Input As #f
    mode = ""
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, L
        L = Trim$(L)
        If L = "[CLIPS]" Then
            mode = "CLIPS"
        ElseIf L = "[MARKUP]" Then
            mode = "MARKUP"
        ElseIf L <> "" Then
            If mode = "CLIPS" Then
                ClipList_Add L
            ElseIf mode = "MARKUP" Then
                MarkupList_Add L
            End If
        End If
    Loop
    Close #f
End Sub

Public Sub SaveLogFile()
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim i As Long
    f = FreeFile
    Open logFilePath For Output As #f

    ' Write clips
    Print #f, "[CLIPS]"
    For i = LBound(ClipList) To UBound(ClipList)
        If Trim$(ClipList(i)) <> "" Then
            Print #f, ClipList(i)
        End If
    Next i

    ' Write markup safely
    Print #f, ""
    Print #f, "[MARKUP]"
    If IsMarkupInitialized() Then
        For i = LBound(MarkupList) To UBound(MarkupList)
            If Trim$(MarkupList(i)) <> "" Then
                Print #f, MarkupList(i)
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    Close #f
End Sub

' --------------------------------
' Logging actions
' --------------------------------
Public Sub WriteLog(ByVal msg As String)
    Dim ts As String
    ts = Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & " :: " & msg
    MarkupList_Add ts
    SaveLogFile
    On Error Resume Next
    MSCP_CLIP_FORM.RefreshMarkupTextbox
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' --------------------------------
' Subclass Procs
' --------------------------------
Public Function ListProc(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal uMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
    If uMsg = WM_COMMAND Then
        Dim ctlID As Long
        Dim notifyCode As Long
        ctlID = wParam And &HFFFF&
        notifyCode = (wParam \ &H10000) And &HFFFF&
        If ctlID = IDC_LIST And notifyCode = LBN_SELCHANGE Then
            On Error Resume Next
            MSCP_CLIP_FORM.DoListClick
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    End If

    ListProc = CallWindowProc(gPrevProcList, hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam)
End Function
Public Function GetEditText(ByVal hWnd As Long) As String
    Dim nLen As Long
    nLen = SendMessage(hWnd, WM_GETTEXTLENGTH, 0, 0)
    If nLen <= 0 Then
        GetEditText = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim buf As String
    buf = String$(nLen + 1, vbNullChar)  ' allocate buffer, +1 for null terminator

    ' Retrieve the text
    Call SendMessageStr(hWnd, WM_GETTEXT, nLen + 1, buf)

    ' Trim at the null terminator
    Dim posNull As Long
    posNull = InStr(buf, vbNullChar)
    If posNull > 0 Then
        GetEditText = Left$(buf, posNull - 1)
    Else
        GetEditText = buf
    End If
End Function
Public Function BtnCopyProc(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal uMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
    If uMsg = WM_LBUTTONDOWN Then MSCP_CLIP_FORM.hBtnCopy_Click
    BtnCopyProc = CallWindowProc(gPrevProcCopy, hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam)
End Function

Public Function BtnPasteProc(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal uMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
    If uMsg = WM_LBUTTONDOWN Then MSCP_CLIP_FORM.hBtnPaste_Click
    BtnPasteProc = CallWindowProc(gPrevProcPaste, hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam)
End Function

Public Function BtnClearProc(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal uMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
    If uMsg = WM_LBUTTONDOWN Then MSCP_CLIP_FORM.hBtnClear_Click
    BtnClearProc = CallWindowProc(gPrevProcClear, hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam)
End Function

Public Function BtnSaveMarkupProc(ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal uMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
    If uMsg = WM_LBUTTONDOWN Then MSCP_CLIP_FORM.hBtnSaveMarkup_Click
    BtnSaveMarkupProc = CallWindowProc(gPrevProcCopy, hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam)
End Function

' --------------------------------
' Application start
' --------------------------------
Public Sub Main()
    If logFilePath = "" Then logFilePath = App.Path & "\ClipboardLog.txt"
    LoadLogFile logFilePath
    Load MSCP_CLIP_FORM
    MSCP_CLIP_FORM.Show
End Sub
```

```
VERSION 5.00
Begin VB.Form MSCP_CLIP_FORM 
   Caption         =   "Clipboard Manager (Cosmic Compact)"
   ClientHeight    =   5310
   ClientLeft      =   0
   ClientTop       =   0
   ClientWidth     =   12090
   ScaleHeight     =   5310
   ScaleWidth      =   12090
   StartUpPosition =   2  'CenterScreen
End
Attribute VB_Name = "MSCP_CLIP_FORM"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Load()
    ' Create window controls dynamically
    hEdit = CreateWindowEx(0, "EDIT", "", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or WS_BORDER, _
        10, 10, 400, 100, Me.hWnd, IDC_EDIT, App.hInstance, 0)

    hList = CreateWindowEx(0, "LISTBOX", "", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or WS_BORDER Or WS_TABSTOP, _
        10, 120, 400, 150, Me.hWnd, IDC_LIST, App.hInstance, 0)

    hBtnCopy = CreateWindowEx(0, "BUTTON", "Copy", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or BS_PUSHBUTTON, _
        10, 280, 90, 30, Me.hWnd, IDC_BTN_COPY, App.hInstance, 0)
    hBtnPaste = CreateWindowEx(0, "BUTTON", "Paste", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or BS_PUSHBUTTON, _
        110, 280, 90, 30, Me.hWnd, IDC_BTN_PASTE, App.hInstance, 0)
    hBtnClear = CreateWindowEx(0, "BUTTON", "Clear", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or BS_PUSHBUTTON, _
        210, 280, 90, 30, Me.hWnd, IDC_BTN_CLEAR, App.hInstance, 0)
    hBtnSaveMarkup = CreateWindowEx(0, "BUTTON", "Save Markup", WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or BS_PUSHBUTTON, _
        310, 280, 90, 30, Me.hWnd, IDC_BTN_SAVE_MARKUP, App.hInstance, 0)

    ' Markup multiline edit
    Dim style As Long
    style = WS_CHILD Or WS_VISIBLE Or WS_BORDER Or ES_MULTILINE Or ES_AUTOVSCROLL Or WS_VSCROLL
    hMarkup = CreateWindowEx(0, "EDIT", "", style, _
        420, 10, 360, 300, Me.hWnd, IDC_MARKUP, App.hInstance, 0)

    ' Make the form always on top
    SetWindowPos Me.hWnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, _
        SWP_NOMOVE Or SWP_NOSIZE Or SWP_SHOWWINDOW

    ' Initialize log path if not set
    If logFilePath = "" Then logFilePath = App.Path & "\ClipboardLog.txt"

    ' Load data from log
    LoadLogFile logFilePath

    ' Refresh UI
    RefreshClipListbox
    RefreshMarkupTextbox

    ' Subclass
    InstallSubclassButtons
    SubclassListBox
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
    UninstallSubclassButtons
    UnSubclassListBox
End Sub

Public Sub RefreshClipListbox()
    Dim i As Long
    SendMessage hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0
    If (Not (Not ClipList)) Then
        For i = LBound(ClipList) To UBound(ClipList)
            If Trim$(ClipList(i)) <> "" Then
                SendMessageStr hList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, ClipList(i)
            End If
        Next i
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub RefreshMarkupTextbox()
    Dim sb As String
    Dim i As Long
    sb = ""
    If IsMarkupInitialized() Then
        For i = 0 To MarkupCount() - 1
            sb = sb & GetMarkupItem(i) & vbCrLf
        Next i
    End If
    SendMessageStr hMarkup, WM_SETTEXT, 0, sb
End Sub

Public Sub DoListClick()
    Dim idx As Long
    Dim ln As Long
    Dim buf As String

    idx = SendMessage(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0)
    If idx < 0 Then Exit Sub

    ln = SendMessage(hList, LB_GETTEXTLEN, idx, 0)
    If ln <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    buf = String$(ln + 1, vbNullChar)
    SendMessageStr hList, LB_GETTEXT, idx, buf
    buf = Left$(buf, InStr(buf, vbNullChar) - 1)

    SendMessageStr hEdit, WM_SETTEXT, 0, buf
End Sub

Public Sub SubclassListBox()
    If hList <> 0 Then
        gPrevProcList = SetWindowLong(hList, GWL_WNDPROC, AddressOf ListProc)
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub UnSubclassListBox()
    If gPrevProcList <> 0 Then
        SetWindowLong hList, GWL_WNDPROC, gPrevProcList
        gPrevProcList = 0
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub InstallSubclassButtons()
    If hBtnCopy <> 0 Then gPrevProcCopy = SetWindowLong(hBtnCopy, GWL_WNDPROC, AddressOf BtnCopyProc)
    If hBtnPaste <> 0 Then gPrevProcPaste = SetWindowLong(hBtnPaste, GWL_WNDPROC, AddressOf BtnPasteProc)
    If hBtnClear <> 0 Then gPrevProcClear = SetWindowLong(hBtnClear, GWL_WNDPROC, AddressOf BtnClearProc)
    If hBtnSaveMarkup <> 0 Then gPrevProcCopy = SetWindowLong(hBtnSaveMarkup, GWL_WNDPROC, AddressOf BtnSaveMarkupProc)
End Sub

Public Sub UninstallSubclassButtons()
    On Error Resume Next
    If hBtnCopy <> 0 And gPrevProcCopy <> 0 Then SetWindowLong hBtnCopy, GWL_WNDPROC, gPrevProcCopy
    If hBtnPaste <> 0 And gPrevProcPaste <> 0 Then SetWindowLong hBtnPaste, GWL_WNDPROC, gPrevProcPaste
    If hBtnClear <> 0 And gPrevProcClear <> 0 Then SetWindowLong hBtnClear, GWL_WNDPROC, gPrevProcClear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Public Sub hBtnCopy_Click()
    Dim txt As String
    'txt = Trim$(GetEditText(hEdit))
    If Len(txt) = 0 Then
        WriteLog "Nothing to copy"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Clipboard.Clear
    Clipboard.SetText txt

    ClipList_Add txt
    SaveLogFile
    RefreshClipListbox
    WriteLog "Copied"
End Sub

Public Sub hBtnPaste_Click()
    Dim buff As String
    buff = Clipboard.GetText
    If buff = "" Then
        WriteLog "Clipboard empty"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If GetEditText(hEdit) = "" Then
        SendMessageStr hEdit, WM_SETTEXT, 0, buff
        WriteLog "Pasted into empty box"
    Else
        SendMessageStr hEdit, EM_REPLACESEL, 1, buff
        WriteLog "Pasted"
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub hBtnClear_Click()
    SendMessage hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0
    Clipboard.Clear
    SendMessageStr hEdit, WM_SETTEXT, 0, ""

    ReDim ClipList(0)
    ClipList(0) = ""
    SaveLogFile
    RefreshClipListbox
    WriteLog "Cleared list, clipboard, and edit box"
End Sub

Public Sub hBtnSaveMarkup_Click()
    Dim lenText As Long
    Dim buff As String
    Dim lines As Variant
    Dim i As Long

    lenText = SendMessage(hMarkup, WM_GETTEXTLENGTH, 0, 0)
    If lenText <= 0 Then
        ClearMarkup
        SaveLogFile
        RefreshMarkupTextbox
        Exit Sub
    End If

    buff = String$(lenText + 1, vbNullChar)
    SendMessageStr hMarkup, WM_GETTEXT, lenText + 1, buff
    buff = Left$(buff, InStr(buff, vbNullChar) - 1)

    lines = Split(buff, vbCrLf)
    ClearMarkup
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        If Trim$(lines(i)) <> "" Then
            AddMarkup Trim$(lines(i))
        End If
    Next i

    SaveLogFile
    RefreshMarkupTextbox
    WriteLog "Saved markup (manual)"
End Sub
```

```
﻿/* Cosmic Codex common styles */
:root {
  --bg: #0b0f19;
  --ink: #e6e3d3;
  --gold: #f0c86e;
  --silver: #bfc7d5;
  --sapphire: #5ac8fa;
  --emerald: #4cd964;
  --accent: #9b59b6;
  --link: #67e8f9;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Georgia", serif; }

.wrapper { max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2rem; }
.banner { border: 1px solid var(--silver); padding: 1rem; text-align: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
.banner h1 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0; color: var(--gold); }
.subtitle { color: var(--silver); font-style: italic; }

nav { margin-top: 1rem; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }
nav a { color: var(--link); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--silver); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 6px; }
nav a:hover { background: rgba(103,232,249,0.1); }

hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--silver); margin: 2rem 0; }

.section { margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.section h2 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: var(--gold); }

/* Table of Contents */
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.codex-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.codex-table th, .codex-table td { border: 1px solid var(--silver); padding: 0; }
.codex-table th { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: var(--gold); padding: 0.5rem; text-align: left; }
.codex-table td a {
  display: block;             /* make the anchor fill the cell */
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.codex-table tr:nth-child(even) td a { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.codex-table td a:hover { background: rgba(240,200,110,0.12); color: var(--gold); }

/* Seal color ribbons for chapters */
.ribbon { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-left: 0.5rem; }
.ribbon.renewal { background: rgba(240,200,110,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--gold); color: var(--gold); }
.ribbon.governance { background: rgba(191,199,213,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--silver); color: var(--silver); }
.ribbon.archive { background: rgba(90,200,250,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--sapphire); color: var(--sapphire); }
.ribbon.prophecy { background: rgba(76,217,100,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--emerald); color: var(--emerald); }

/* Footer */
.footer { margin-top: 2rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--silver); }
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "WebCaller"
' ===== Module: WebCaller.bas =====
Option Explicit

Private Declare Function InternetOpen Lib "wininet.dll" _
    Alias "InternetOpenA" (ByVal sAgent As String, _
    ByVal lAccessType As Long, ByVal sProxyName As String, _
    ByVal sProxyBypass As String, ByVal lFlags As Long) As Long

Private Declare Function InternetOpenUrl Lib "wininet.dll" _
    Alias "InternetOpenUrlA" (ByVal hInternetSession As Long, _
    ByVal sUrl As String, ByVal sHeaders As String, _
    ByVal lHeadersLength As Long, ByVal lFlags As Long, _
    ByVal lContext As Long) As Long

Private Declare Function InternetReadFile Lib "wininet.dll" _
    (ByVal hFile As Long, ByVal lpBuffer As String, _
    ByVal dwNumberOfBytesToRead As Long, _
    ByRef lNumberOfBytesRead As Long) As Integer

Private Declare Function InternetCloseHandle Lib "wininet.dll" _
    (ByVal hInet As Long) As Integer

Public Function HttpGet(ByVal sUrl As String) As String
    Dim hInternet As Long, hUrl As Long
    Dim sBuffer As String * 4096   ' bigger buffer
    Dim lBytesRead As Long
    Dim sResult As String
    
    hInternet = InternetOpen("VB6WebCaller", 1, vbNullString, vbNullString, 0)
    If hInternet = 0 Then Exit Function
    
    hUrl = InternetOpenUrl(hInternet, sUrl, vbNullString, 0, 0, 0)
    If hUrl = 0 Then
        InternetCloseHandle hInternet
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Do
        If InternetReadFile(hUrl, sBuffer, Len(sBuffer), lBytesRead) = 0 Then Exit Do
        If lBytesRead > 0 Then
            sResult = sResult & Left$(sBuffer, lBytesRead)
        End If
    Loop While lBytesRead > 0
    
    InternetCloseHandle hUrl
    InternetCloseHandle hInternet
    
    HttpGet = sResult
End Function

Public Sub Main()
    Dim response As String
    response = HttpGet("http://copilot.microsoft.com")
    
    Load WebCallerFrm
    WebCallerFrm.Text1.Text = response   ' use .Text property
    WebCallerFrm.Visible = True
End Sub
```
